sections.Profile:
The "Trinidad" pinball machine, released by Chicago Coin Machine Co. in March 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game themed around the Caribbean island of Trinidad. Designed by Jerry Koci with artwork by Roy Parker, the playfield features two flippers, eleven passive bumpers, and four kick-out holes, offering players a dynamic and engaging experience.
